notes.title: Patch - June 20th, 2025
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Thanks for the early feedback. We have fixed some bugs which were annoying and needed to go.

Fixes:

-Graphical issue where some area of certain buildings were flickering.
-Fixed objects which appeared to be floating.
-Fixed one AI which was behaving not as intended.
-Updated Shadow options which provides more detailed shadows
-Few other minor fixes.

Thank you for playing Wiped Clean. Hope you will have lots of fun :)

notes.title: Wiped Clean Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Wiped Clean Demo is Here! 
[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/fc546d9aacc84cbe7f5c9419922b0583f6a3a203.png[/img]

The wait is over—step into the eerie world of Wiped Clean! The official demo is now available, giving you a first taste of the crime scene cleaning thriller where every stain hides a secret.

[list]
[*] Clean up disturbing murder scenes
[*] Uncover hidden clues behind each crime
[*] Piece together a deadly conspiracy
[/list]

Are you ready to erase the evidence… or will you uncover something you weren’t meant to see?

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437820/Wiped_Clean/
